title: Cortex — hardware status
description: The current Cortex backplane: busboard v3.1, with connectors and pinouts.
body: The current Cortex backplane is **busboard v3.1**, as pinned by release [Cortex v0.3](/releases/cortex-v0.3). Validation differs per board — see each component's page for its status. Earlier generations stay available on the [busboard component page](/components/busboard).
